items.source: Create a builder with the given HTTP method, URI template, and variables.
items.translation: 使用给定的 HTTP 方法、URI 模板和变量创建一个构建器。

items.source: Uses of RequestEntity.BodyBuilder in org.springframework.http
items.translation: `RequestEntity.BodyBuilder` 接口在 `org.springframework.http` 包中的用法

items.source: Set the media type of the body, as specified by the Content-Type header.
items.translation: 设置正文的媒体类型，如Content-Type头中指定。

items.source: Set the length of the body in bytes, as specified by the Content-Length header.
items.translation: 设置以 Content-Length 标头指定的字节数作为正文长度。

items.source: Contains a basic abstraction over client/server-side HTTP.
items.translation: 包含对客户端/服务端 HTTP 的基本抽象。

items.source: Defines a builder that adds a body to the response entity.
items.translation: 定义一个向响应实体添加主体的构建器。
